Paintless dent repair in Bellingham

Repair the dent.
Keep the finish that came with your car.

From an everyday parking-lot ding to a crease in a body panel, Showtime helps Bellingham drivers find out whether their dent can be repaired without sanding, filler or repainting.

When the paint and panel are a good fit, paintless repair reshapes the metal so your original finish stays intact.

Why Choose Paintless Dent Repair?

  • Factory paint preserved

    For dents with intact paint when the panel can be reshaped without refinishing.

  • No sanding or repainting

    Suitable dents are reshaped without body filler or a new coat of paint.

  • An honest assessment

    We consider dent depth, panel access and the condition of the original finish.

  • Based in Bellingham

Paintless dent repair · Bellingham, Washington

The first question is whether a dent can be fixed while keeping the original finish. A close look at the paint, the shape of the dent and the back of the panel helps determine the answer.

When paintless repair is a good fit, we can reshape the metal without sanding it down, adding filler or repainting.

  • Intact paint
  • Careful panel assessment
  • Precise metal reshaping
  • Factory finish preserved
